name: Cinder Control
tagline: A wildfire-spread dashboard that predicts what a fire will reach and helps responders plan.

awards: Second Place for NorthMark Compute & Cloud Challenge

problem: People in wildfire areas often do not understand fire spread, the builder says.
solution: Models fire spread from environmental parameters set by form or voice, shows threatened landmarks on a map with weather data, and offers responder tools.
demo_moment: Team-described: set wind and dryness and watch the predicted spread.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Solo Hack” and “Second Place for NorthMark Compute & Cloud Challenge” among 176 submissions.
A solo project that also placed in the HPC challenge.

lessons: Simulation plus a map makes risk visible.
